fields.Trigger: New B2B customer applies for trade credit

Automation Opportunity: - Credit-score auto-computed from the financial-data feed; credit-limit auto-suggested from the scoring model; collection-aging auto-tracked with escalation
Controls: - CTL-433 (credit-authorization — links to VS-16 / W24); Operational: Credit Analyst sign-off on the workflow output
Pain Points / Risks: - **Credit-default risk**: a trade account defaults on extended credit, creating a bad-debt write-off; mitigated by the credit-scoring model and the credit-limit monitoring

- Mobile app (links to VS-75 / digital engagement app, VS-10 / ecommerce)
Time Estimate: - Absorbed into the Credit Analyst role; not incremental headcount unless volume scales significantly.
